mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 2.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a tightening labor market that accelerates economic growth, reducing recession risk and supporting positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 0.5% MoM and UNRATE decline > 0.1pp MoM (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth above 3.0% annualized indicates late-cycle economic expansion where monetary tightening expectations rise, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansions (GDP growth > 3.0% annualized).

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity that accelerates economic growth, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO growth > 0.5% MoM (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1200.0 thousand units indicate a contracting construction sector that signals economic weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1200.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A high CPIAUCSL (above 250) combined with low FEDFUNDS (below 2.0%) signals an unsustainable inflationary environment that triggers expectations of imminent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 250 and FEDFUNDS < 2.0 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rates below 3.0% indicate an ultra-tight labor market that fuels wage inflation and triggers aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).
